title: CSS layout rules
description: Deterministic layout and style rules for CSS, SCSS, LESS, CSS modules and Tailwind projects.

rules.title: Do not hide overflow on the document root
rules.message: Root overflow is hidden; content beyond the viewport becomes unreachable.
rules.fix: Find the element that overflows and fix its sizing; use local scrolling only where intended.
rules.rationale: Hiding root overflow masks layout defects and hides content from users.

rules.title: !important outside @layer utilities or reset files
rules.message: !important is used outside a utility layer or reset file.
rules.fix: Fix the specificity problem, or move the declaration into the utilities layer.
rules.rationale: !important makes later overrides impossible and hides cascade mistakes.

rules.title: transition: all
rules.message: transition: all animates every property, including layout properties.
rules.fix: List the properties that should animate.
rules.rationale: Animating everything causes jank and unexpected motion when styles change.

rules.title: Fixed height with overflow hidden in the same block
rules.message: A fixed height combined with hidden overflow can clip text, errors or translations.
rules.fix: Use min-height or intrinsic height and verify with long content and zoom.
rules.rationale: Fixed boxes that hide overflow lose content as soon as text grows.

rules.title: outline none without a :focus-visible replacement
rules.message: The focus outline is removed and no :focus-visible style replaces it in this file.
rules.fix: Keep the default outline or add a visible :focus-visible style.
rules.rationale: Keyboard users lose track of focus when the indicator disappears.

rules.title: More than six position: absolute declarations in one file
rules.message: The file positions many elements absolutely, which usually means coordinate-based layout.
rules.fix: Use grid, flex or normal flow for structure; keep absolute positioning for justified layers.
rules.rationale: Coordinate layouts match one screenshot and break with other content or viewports.

rules.title: Literal z-index not using a --z-* token
rules.message: z-index uses a literal number instead of a --z-* token.
rules.fix: Define the layer as a token (--z-modal) and reference it with var().
rules.rationale: Magic stacking numbers escalate and collide; named layers stay reviewable.

rules.title: filter: invert() in a dark theme
rules.message: A dark theme is built by inverting colours, which breaks photos, states and contrast.
rules.fix: Define semantic colour roles per theme and validate each pair.
rules.rationale: Inversion makes contrast unpredictable; dark themes need their own validated palette.

rules.title: Animation without a reduced-motion alternative
rules.message: An animation runs with no prefers-reduced-motion handling in this file.
rules.fix: Wrap it in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference or add a reduce override.
rules.rationale: Motion can trigger discomfort; users can ask for less of it.

rules.title: font-size in vw without clamp()
rules.message: font-size depends only on the viewport width, so it ignores user text settings.
rules.fix: Wrap the value in clamp() with rem bounds.
rules.rationale: Pure viewport units stop text from scaling with zoom and user preferences.

rules.title: @font-face without font-display
rules.fix: Add font-display: swap (or the strategy your project chose).
rules.rationale: Without it browsers may hide text while the font loads.

rules.title: Physical direction properties where logical ones express reading direction

params.guidance: Prefer logical properties (margin-inline-start, padding-block, inset-inline) where spacing follows the reading direction, so right-to-left layouts need no overrides.

rules.message: Physical direction properties may need overrides for right-to-left languages.
rules.fix: Use logical properties where the spacing follows the reading direction.
rules.rationale: Logical properties adapt to writing mode and direction without extra rules.
